scope: small synthetic operational campaign; no real refrigeration utility inference

arms.candidateAppend: Before final source, silently check finite values, both exact domain endpoints, absent input representation and required named argument. Keep explicit refusals as unreachable(). Make no defaults. Return only source.

metric: all assigned requests machine-completed-valid; unsupported and underdetermined separate counted strata
adoptionRule: adopt only strict completion improvement on both development and holdout, zero guardrail regressions; otherwise no-evidence or reject
uncertainty: descriptive matched counts and exact paired sign-test; tiny N does not establish broad advantage
powerRule: no expansion from this small run; no posthoc changes to arms, thresholds or holdout
